facts.text: Deborah finds peace in nature, which helps her find clarity and perspective.

evidence.quote: It's like hitting a reset button that helps me put things into perspective and gives me time to reflect.
It's amazing how nature has the power to bring us peace and clarity.

facts.text: Jolene enjoys going for walks and taking photos to help her reflect and find peace.

evidence.quote: Whenever I can, I love going for walks to take it all in. And I take photos like this [image: a photo of a sunset over a body of water]
It makes me feel so peaceful and tranquil.

facts.text: Jolene's photo of a dock on a lake with trees in the background captures the peacefulness of the location.

evidence.quote: This photo captures the peacefulness of a lake surrounded by trees.
